what_it_does.text: Zenaris is a TV box with a built in webcam for the older person's own television, plus a remote with twelve large buttons. Each button can be set to live TV, radio, a calendar or a video call to one person, so one press starts the call on screen. Relatives use a phone app to call, send photos and set reminders, and a home care service can post messages such as a changed visit time.

sources.quote: eine tv-box mit integrierter webcam und fernbedienung mit großen tasten
jede der zwölf tasten in der größe eines quadratischen schokoladen-täfelchens ist individuell belegbar
angehörige und pflegende steuern alles bequem per smartphone: videoanrufe starten, fotos senden, erinnerungen einrichten
mitteilung pflegedienst anna kommt heute erst um 16:30 vorbei

why_interesting.text: Hakan Evcek, a Goethe University Frankfurt finance graduate, and Tim Jefferys, a TU Darmstadt industrial engineer, built a dummy in a TU Darmstadt entrepreneurship seminar after Oma Henny was isolated during Covid. Software developer Manuel Kraus joined in March 2024 as CTO. Zenaris GmbH was registered in September 2025. It runs on an EXIST founder grant since January 2025 plus prize money; no equity funding round was found. The insight: sales run through home care services, which gain client contact without extra trips, and a care aid listing would let the care fund pay instead of the family.
